source: OpenAI's list prices for its API, standard tier, short context (at most 272K input tokens), as https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing published them on 2026-10-13; a Codex subject on a ChatGPT login is not billed per token, so the figure is the list price of the tokens Codex reported, and Codex reports cache writes as 0, so a written token is priced as uncached input, at most 20 % under OpenAI's cache-write price for it
unit: USD per million tokens; input is uncached input, cacheWrite is OpenAI's cache-write price, cacheRead its cached-input price
